final: WITH u AS (SELECT t.transreg, t.ordertypedist AS mix, AVG(s.instownpct) AS own FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.transreg, t.ordertypedist), u2 AS (SELECT * FROM u WHERE own IS NOT NULL), b AS (SELECT mix, AVG(own) AS base FROM u2 GROUP BY mix), o AS (SELECT AVG(own) AS overall FROM u2) SELECT AVG(u2.own) AS avg_own, AVG(u2.own / b.base) AS avg_ratio, AVG(u2.own - o.overall) AS avg_excess FROM u2 JOIN b ON u2.mix = b.mix CROSS JOIN o WHERE u2.own > o.overall
